en-US.title: Is this combination real? I tried 3 new menu items from "Cozy House X Chinese Cuisine Master Lee ...
en-US.description:
- Cozy House with its cozy and warm atmosphere 🏡
It's a great place for a family meal,
and also a perfect date spot for couples ♥️

The 10th of every month is $10 Day 🥩
👉 $10 steaks are half price,
and at a whopping 7,000 won, it's a great value.

(The Gangnam Station main branch is 7,500 won)

I tried some of the new menu items,
and while they're familiar, the flavors feel a little more intense.

🍖 Dongpo Pork Steak 19,900 won
🍝 Mala Seafood Pasta 18,900 won
🍤 Kkanpung Chili Shrimp 15,900 won

It had a different appeal from the regular Cozy House menu,
so I ordered a couple and shared them.

If you're looking for a comfortable atmosphere and a slightly different menu, this is a great place to visit 🙂

📍 Cozy House Gangnam Station Main Branch
2F, 10 Gangnam-daero 94-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul
